text: This staff report is about a matter that Community Council has delegated authority from City Council to make a final decision. This report outlines our investigation into reducing the speed limit on Bala Avenue from 40 km/h to 30 km/h, between Jane Street and Bartonville Avenue West. The results indicate that the criteria to reduce the speed limit are satisfied.
Etobicoke York Community Council: 1. Reduced the speed limit from 40 km/h to 30 km/h on Bala Avenue, between Jane Street and Bartonville Avenue West.
